subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement (FinPath)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement (FinPath)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak this morning — great to learn more about FinPath's roadmap for intelligent customer support and the need to reduce latency for high-volume chat flows. Quick recap from our end: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-interaction cost while keeping sub-200ms tail latency for conversational flows.
- Workloads: mix of short customer queries (~30 tokens) and long context threads (~1k tokens).
- Constraints: must meet FinPath security/compliance requirements (SOC 2 + limited data retention) and integrate with their platform team for auth/networking.

Next step: schedule a 45–60 minute demo + technical deep-dive where Rishi (solutions) can walk through architecture and Neha (security) can validate controls. Below are time windows that work on our side (PST):

- Tue 12/1: 9:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 12/2: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00

Can you please confirm which slot works for you and loop in the FinPath security and procurement leads so we can address SSO, retention, and contract questions in one meeting? I’ve attached a brief SOC2 summary and a SOW template for procurement to review ahead of time.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Template.docx

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the SOC2 summary. Jared (security) and Monica (procurement) looped in. We can do a demo + technical deep-dive — our availability (PST):

- Tue 12/1: 14:00–15:00 (best)
- Wed 12/2: 10:30–11:30

If you can hold the 12/1 14:00 slot tentatively, that would be great — Monica wants to review the SOW template before the meeting, and Jared will want the SOC2 section covered in the first 15 minutes. If possible, could Rishi include an architecture slide about private VPC deployments and KMS/HSM integrations?

Thanks — I’ll wait for invite and any prep materials.

—Samir

Thanks Samir — looping in our internal folks: Neha (security) and Rishi (solutions) plus Stephanie (your AE for contracting).

12/1 at 14:00 PST works on our end — I’ll send a calendar invite for 12/1 14:00–15:00 PST and include an agenda. Rishi — can you please plan to cover:

1) high-level architecture and deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private VPC) — ~15 mins
2) quantization/latency tradeoffs for FinPath workloads — ~10 mins
3) integration checklist (SSO, KMS, network egress) — ~10 mins
4) procurement/contract next steps — ~10 mins

Neha — appreciate if you can flag any specific docs Jared should review beforehand; I attached the SOC2 summary but we can surface a short controls mapping if helpful.

Samir/Monica/Jared — any other invites to add?

Thanks,
Marissa
